description: OpenClaw-class finance, procurement, and payment-execution guardrail pointers.

concepts.description: Require vendor identity verification before finance actions proceed.
Block payment flows that include new or changed bank details.

implementations.python: lambda request: {'blocked': True, 'reason': 'bank detail changes require separate verification', 'request': request}

concepts.description: Require two independent approvals before a finance action proceeds.
